map.为什么线损是 I²R 不是 IR？: Why is line loss I²R rather than IR?
map.功率=电压×电流，线路压降=IR，损耗=压降×电流=I²R，故损耗随电流平方上升: Power = voltage × current, line voltage drop = IR, loss = voltage drop × current = I²R, so the loss rises with the square of the current.
